payload.body: **Before you land src/config.rs: one review point from the parked diff (555eb7e).** cc's WP11 needs only the clock: Config::now (src/sync.rs:1157 is its one caller) with PPLR_TODAY's two forms and pinned_clock. Leave the new home field out of this commit; it is WP14's. When it does land with WP14, read HOME through the existing home() in config.rs rather than a second get("HOME"), so HOME has one reader (Highlander). The rest reads right against the WP14 ruling: one clock setting, a date meaning its midnight or a date and a time, local zone.
